title: Heavenly Andalusian Potatoes Tart
description: A jammy, silky, indulgent Spanish dish featuring charlotte potatoes, lamination-puff, and Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice potatoes into 1-2 mm rounds, rinse and pat dry.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat; sauté potatoes with salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Spread the apricot jam over the puff pastry sheet in the center, leaving a 1 cm border.
Arrange the sautéed potato slices over the jam in a circular pattern, overlapping slightly.
Whisk together heavy cream, egg yolk, and melted butter until smooth.
Pour the cream mixture evenly over the potatoes, ensuring full coverage.
Fold the pastry edges toward the center to enclose the filling, then brush the top with remaining cream mixture.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is golden and the filling is set.
Remove from oven, let cool 5 minutes, then sprinkle chopped parsley and serve warm.
